title: Fire at Starlink site in Bulgaria after suspected sabotage in Poland
title_zh: 波兰疑似遭蓄意破坏后，保加利亚的星链站点发生火灾

paragraphs.en: Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev confirmed on Wednesday that there had been a fire at a facility of the Starlink satellite internet service near the capital Sofia last week.
paragraphs.zh: 保加利亚总理鲁门·拉德夫周三证实，上周首都索非亚附近星链卫星互联网服务的一处设施曾发生火灾。

paragraphs.en: Two young men holding German passports have been taken into custody in connection with the suspected attack, Bulgarian media later reported, citing investigators.
paragraphs.zh: 据保加利亚媒体随后援引调查人员的话报道，两名持有德国护照的年轻男子因涉嫌参与此次袭击已被拘留。

paragraphs.en: The satellite network is a strategically important part of Ukraine's defence in the war against Russia's invasion.
paragraphs.zh: 该卫星网络是乌克兰抵御俄罗斯入侵战争中国防战略的重要组成部分。

paragraphs.en: The fire had previously been made public by the pro-Western opposition alliance Democratic Bulgaria (DB). Radev said he would not provide any further details in light of the ongoing investigations.
paragraphs.zh: 这起火灾此前已由亲西方反对党联盟“民主保加利亚”（DB）公开。 拉德夫表示，鉴于调查正在进行中，他不会提供任何进一步细节。

sents.en: The fire had previously been made public by the pro-Western opposition alliance Democratic Bulgaria (DB).
sents.zh: 这起火灾此前已由亲西方反对党联盟“民主保加利亚”（DB）公开。

sents.en: Radev said he would not provide any further details in light of the ongoing investigations.
sents.zh: 拉德夫表示，鉴于调查正在进行中，他不会提供任何进一步细节。

paragraphs.en: According to DB, 11 of 17 antennas at a Starlink facility near Sofia were deliberately set on fire on October 9. The antennas were used in the war in Ukraine, DB said.
paragraphs.zh: 据数据库（DB）称，10月9日，索菲亚附近一个星链（Starlink）设施的17根天线中有11根被人蓄意纵火焚毁。 数据库（DB）称，这些天线曾在乌克兰战争中使用。

sents.en: According to DB, 11 of 17 antennas at a Starlink facility near Sofia were deliberately set on fire on October 9.
sents.zh: 据数据库（DB）称，10月9日，索菲亚附近一个星链（Starlink）设施的17根天线中有11根被人蓄意纵火焚毁。

sents.en: The antennas were used in the war in Ukraine, DB said.
sents.zh: 数据库（DB）称，这些天线曾在乌克兰战争中使用。

paragraphs.en: Pro-Western opposition parties said they suspected Russia was linked to the attack.
paragraphs.zh: 亲西方的反对党表示，他们怀疑俄罗斯与此次袭击有关联。

paragraphs.en: Two men aged 20 and 21, both holding German passports, were detained in Bulgaria on Monday in connection with the suspected attack, several Bulgarian media outlets reported on Wednesday evening, citing investigators.
paragraphs.zh: 据保加利亚多家媒体周三晚间援引调查人员的话报道，两名年龄分别为20岁和21岁、均持有德国护照的男子，因涉嫌与此次袭击有关，于周一在保加利亚被拘留。

paragraphs.en: According to the news outlet Faktor.bg, the two suspects have migrant backgrounds and had legally entered Bulgaria from Greece through the Kulata border crossing.
paragraphs.zh: 据新闻媒体 Faktor.bg 报道，两名嫌疑人有移民背景，他们通过库拉塔（Kulata）边境检查站从希腊合法入境保加利亚。

paragraphs.en: The website reported that investigators were examining whether the suspects belonged to a larger sabotage network potentially linked to two men arrested in Germany earlier this week over a recent attack on a Starlink facility in Poland.
paragraphs.zh: 据报道，调查人员正在查明这些嫌疑人是否属于一个更大的破坏网络，该网络可能与此前提到的两名在德国被捕的男子有关联，这两人因近期对波兰一处星链设施发动袭击而被捕。

paragraphs.en: Bulgarian officials stressed that the Starlink facility near Sofia was privately owned.
paragraphs.zh: 保加利亚官员强调，索非亚附近的星链设施为私人所有。

paragraphs.en: Bulgarian Interior Minister Ivan Demerdzhiev told parliament that additional security measures had been introduced at similar facilities, even though responsibility for their protection rested with their owners.
paragraphs.zh: 保加利亚内政部长伊万·德梅尔吉耶夫向议会表示，尽管此类设施的保护责任由其所有者承担，但已在类似设施采取了额外的安全措施。

paragraphs.en: Plamen Tonchev, head of Bulgaria's State Agency for National Security (DANS), said he believed the fire at the Starlink facility was an act of sabotage.
paragraphs.zh: 保加利亚国家安全局（DANS）负责人普拉门·通切夫（Plamen Tonchev）表示，他认为星链（Starlink）设施发生的火灾是一起破坏行为。

paragraphs.en: "Such acts of sabotage cannot be ruled out in the future either," he warned lawmakers.
paragraphs.zh: “此类破坏行为在未来也不能排除，”他警告立法者。

paragraphs.en: A fire also broke out at a Starlink ground terminal south of Warsaw on September 23.
paragraphs.zh: 9月23日，华沙南部的一个星链地面终端也发生了火灾。

paragraphs.en: Two suspected saboteurs accused of carrying out that attack in Poland were arrested on Tuesday in Nürtingen, near Stuttgart in south-western Germany.
paragraphs.zh: 周二，两名涉嫌在波兰实施该袭击的疑似破坏分子在德国西南部斯图加特附近的努特林根（Nürtingen）被逮捕。

paragraphs.en: The government in Warsaw suspects Russian intelligence services were behind the attack.
paragraphs.zh: 华沙政府怀疑俄罗斯情报部门是这次攻击的幕后黑手。
